## Proven current transaction

- Exact model `G615LW-S5058W`, part `90NR0LG1-M002P0`, EAN `4711387828038`.

## Proven third-year route

The exact product page advertises one free extra manufacturer-warranty year for purchases from 1 June through 31 December 2026, with serial/invoice registration by 31 January 2027. ASUS's terms say the extra year begins after the original warranty, retains the standard warranty conditions, and excludes software, battery, peripherals/accessories and customer-caused damage. Approval/activation is required.

This creates a zero-cost three-year standard hardware-warranty route for the exact Belgian transaction. It is not Dell ProSupport, not automatically onsite, and has no proven response-time SLA. ASUS lists paid Local On-Site Service through Premium Care, but exact G615LW serial eligibility and price remain visible only after purchase/registration and may not be included in the transaction total.
